title: 36 Hours in Victoria, British Columbia
abstract: On lush Vancouver Island, this urban jewel offers innovative restaurants, gorgeous parks and gardens, and museums that celebrate the area’s many cultures.

title: 36 Hours in Lisbon
abstract: In the Portuguese capital, a weekend’s worth of seafood feasts, chic rooftop bars, undulating streets and landmarks, both Old World and futuristic.

title: 36 Hours in Copenhagen
abstract: In the design-savvy, food-obsessed Danish capital, the only problem for travelers is keeping up with all that is new.
